method.note: Autocomplete API returns a smaller product suggestion payload than full search; autocomplete parity is scored as suggestion coverage, not full search recall.

findings.summary: The all-node parity pass confirms the Blankets browse node under-exposes products returned by search and autocomplete.
evidence: Browse node /collections/blankets returned 2 products from the public collection products feed.
Boost autocomplete for "blankets" returned 3 total products and 3 product suggestions in the response.
Search/autocomplete-only product sample: Lambert Soccer Everest Blanket.
findings.customer_impact: A customer who browses the Blankets collection can miss a product that another customer can find through search or autocomplete.
findings.business_impact: Category browse can under-represent available themed or team-specific products, reducing discovery for shoppers who navigate instead of searching.
findings.recommendation: Add a browse-node parity rule that checks every public collection against the corresponding search and autocomplete product set before reporting parity.

findings.summary: Search and browse product sets are not equal across the evaluated core browse nodes.
evidence: 5/60 category or fan-shop nodes had exact search/browse product-set parity.
13 category or fan-shop nodes exposed search-only products.
51 category or fan-shop nodes exposed browse-only products.
findings.customer_impact: Customers can see different product availability depending on whether they search, use autocomplete, or browse.
findings.business_impact: The site can misstate catalog coverage and create inconsistent merchandising paths across high-intent surfaces.
findings.recommendation: Use this all-node parity evaluator as the required basis for parity claims and tune collection membership, search indexing, and autocomplete payloads together.

findings.summary: Autocomplete does not consistently surface products from the corresponding browse node.
evidence: 47/60 category or fan-shop nodes returned no autocomplete product that matched the corresponding browse-node feed.
findings.customer_impact: Customers typing a browse-node term may not see product suggestions that reinforce the category path.
findings.business_impact: Autocomplete may underuse existing merchandising work and can fail to bridge customers from keyword entry to the right browse area.
findings.recommendation: For each priority browse node, verify that autocomplete includes either direct product suggestions from the node or an explicit collection/category suggestion.
